description: ResumeBench v5 resume extraction target, used with the v5 system prompt (which states every rule in full). Fill every field the resume prints, copied verbatim; use null (an empty list for a list) when it is not printed; an empty string counts as null. Comparison in short: letter case counts, except that ALL-CAPS text (two or more letters, all capitals) equals the same text in any case (email, phone, linkedinUrl (see there), city/state/country, the profiles network and the degree ignore case); in every text value except linkedinUrl (compared as a URL) a run of whitespace counts as one space, and spaces at either end, one or more of . , ; : at the end, , ; : at the start, a leading "." unless an ASCII letter follows it (".NET" keeps it), dash and quote variants, Unicode compatibility forms, soft hyphens, zero-width characters and the markdown markers ** and __ are ignored; list markers are ignored at the start of description items, custom-section lines and skills items, and on every line of a multi-line text value (personalSummary, roleDescription, a summary) when at least two lines carry one; booleans count only when true. Fields whose description starts with UNSCORED are never compared.

basics.description: The resume owner's name, contact details, own location, photo and LinkedIn URL, wherever they are printed (a line of a Personal Details section that fills one of these fields goes here only). Scored: the full name (prefix + fname + lname + suffix as one value), email, phone, city/state/country, hasPersonalPhoto and linkedinUrl.

prefix.description: Title printed before the name, as printed (e.g. "Dr.", "Prof.", a military rank). Null if none. Scored as part of the full name (see lname).

fname.description: Given name(s) when clear, as printed, with middle names, initials and a nickname printed with them: "John Michael" from "John Michael Smith", "Wei (Victor)" from "DENG Wei (Victor)". Copy each name part as printed, its words in printed order. If only one name token is printed, put it here and leave lname null.

lname.description: Family name as printed, including compound surnames ("Van der Berg", "Al Suwaidi"). The full name is compared as one value made of the words of prefix + fname + lname + suffix: which part holds a word, and the order of the words, are not scored ("DENG Wei (Victor)" = "Wei (Victor) DENG"); every word counts, and so does letter case, judged on the whole name ("DENG" printed in capitals stays "DENG").

suffix.description: What is printed right after the name, as printed: "Jr.", "III", "MD", "PhD", "Esq.", "CPA". Null if none. Scored as part of the full name (see lname).

email.description: Email address as printed (compared ignoring case).

phone.description: Phone number exactly as printed, including country code, brackets, spaces and separators.

city.description: City part of the person's own location, as printed (e.g. "New York" from "New York, NY, USA"). city, state and country are compared as one set of parts, ignoring case: a part in another slot is not penalized, a missing or extra part is. Every printed part must be its own value ("Austin, TX" in city matches neither part); copy parts as printed (no expansion such as "NY" -> "New York", no translation) and do not infer a part that is not printed (no country from a city).

state.description: State, province or region part of the person's own location, as printed (e.g. "NY"). Null if not printed. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

country.description: Country part of the person's own location, as printed (e.g. "USA"). Null if not printed; never inferred. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

hasPersonalPhoto.description: true only if the resume shows a photograph of the person (portrait or headshot); logos, icons, decorative graphics and badges do not count. Otherwise false or null (they count the same: only true is compared).

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL as printed. A printed handle or partial path ("/in/jane-doe", or "jane-doe" next to a LinkedIn icon) is the printed URL: copy it as printed; null if only a word or an icon is printed (the URL sits only in a link). Compared as a URL, on everything after the scheme: the scheme, a leading "www.", trailing "/" and letter case are ignored in the host and in linkedin.com paths (a handle or partial path without a host, such as "in/Jane-Doe", ignores case too); case counts in a partial path that starts with "/" and in short links such as lnkd.in; nothing else is folded, so a query (?...), a fragment (#...), another subdomain ("in.linkedin.com"), a trailing "." or a dash variant counts. LinkedIn never goes in profiles.

targetJobTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The headline or target title printed with the name at the top of the resume, as printed (e.g. "Principal Architect - Cloud Platforms"; "Data Analyst" from "Objective: Data Analyst"). Null if none. Never derived from the work history.

dob.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Date of birth as printed (also from a Personal Details section). Null if not printed.

gender.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Gender as printed (also from a Personal Details section). Null if not printed.

nationality.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Nationality or citizenship as printed (also from a Personal Details section). Null if not printed.

address.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Street address as printed (also from a Personal Details section); city/state/country have their own fields. Null if not printed.

postalCode.description: UNSCORED (never compared). ZIP or postal code as printed (also from a Personal Details section). Null if not printed.

openToRemote.description: UNSCORED (never compared). true only if the resume states openness to remote work; otherwise null.

openToRelocate.description: UNSCORED (never compared). true only if the resume states willingness to relocate; otherwise null.

openToOnSite.description: UNSCORED (never compared). true only if the resume states openness to on-site work; otherwise null.

openToHybrid.description: UNSCORED (never compared). true only if the resume states openness to hybrid work; otherwise null.

openToTravel.description: UNSCORED (never compared). true only if the resume states willingness to travel; otherwise null.

experience.description: Work history: one item per role (jobs, internships, part-time and contract roles) from work-history sections, with employer and title; never from summary or profile prose. A separately headed compact list of roles without responsibilities ("Earlier Career", a "Career Summary" timeline) goes to customSections; if the same roles also appear in a detailed work history, take one item per role from the detailed one. Empty items list if the resume has no work history.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

items.description: Roles in printed order. Several titles under one employer with their own dates are separate items; start a new item only where a new role begins.

company.description: Pairing field: experience entries are paired on company + position, so a differing value loses the entry. Employer name exactly as printed in the entry.

position.description: Pairing field: job title exactly as printed in the entry, with nothing appended (no dates, locations or text from other lines) and never taken from the summary.

startMonth.description: Month the role started, integer 1-12 (January = 1). Null if no month is printed (year only, season or quarter).

startYear.description: Year the role started, 4-digit integer. For an ongoing entry ("2020 - Present", "Since 2020") the printed date is the start. Null if not printed. If only ONE date is printed and the entry is not ongoing, it is the end date (endMonth/endYear), not the start.

endMonth.description: Month the role ended, integer 1-12. Null if ongoing or if no end month is printed.

endYear.description: Year the role ended, 4-digit integer; a single printed date of an entry that is not ongoing goes here. Null if ongoing (currentlyWorkHere true) or if no end is printed. (When the ground truth has a single date, that date is also accepted in the start fields or in both.)

currentlyWorkHere.description: true if the role is ongoing ("Present", "Current", "Now", "Since 2020", an open range "2020 -"). Otherwise false or null (they count the same: only true is compared).

location.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The full location of the entry as printed (e.g. "New York, NY, USA"). Null if none.

city.description: City (or town/district) part of the location printed with the role, as printed. city, state and country are compared as one set of parts, ignoring case: a part in another slot is not penalized, a missing or extra part is. Every printed part must be its own value ("Austin, TX" in city matches neither part); copy parts as printed (no expansion such as "NY" -> "New York", no translation) and do not infer a part that is not printed (no country from a city). "Remote" is not a city (see isRemote).

state.description: State, province or region part of the location printed with the role, as printed (e.g. "NY" from "New York, NY"). Null if not printed. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

country.description: Country part of the location printed with the role, as printed (e.g. "USA" from "New York, NY, USA"). Null if not printed; never inferred. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

isRemote.description: true only if the role is marked remote ("Remote", "Work from Home", "WFH", "Telecommute"). Otherwise false or null (they count the same: only true is compared).

roleDescription.description: Unbulleted prose printed inside the entry, verbatim; paragraphs separated by newlines (the breaks between paragraphs are not compared). Null if the role has no prose. Compared as one string. If the prose is written as the first description line(s) instead, the scorer moves those lines here when, joined, they equal the prose; never put prose between bullets. Printed bullets written here as one paragraph count as one merged description line.

companyUrl.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Link printed on the employer name: href = the URL if it is printed (otherwise null), label = the visible text of the link. Null if no link is printed.

href.description: UNSCORED (never compared). URL as printed; null if only the linked text is visible.

label.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Visible text of the link as printed.

description.description: Bullet points of the role, one string per printed bullet, verbatim; a wrapped bullet stays one string, and a sub-heading inside the entry is its own line, in place. Compared as an unordered set of lines: order is not scored, and list markers at the start of a line are ignored (one bullet glyph or symbol such as • ▪ ➤ ◆ ✔ 🚀, with or without a space; a dash or "*" followed by a space or tab; "1.", "1)" or "(1)" with one or two digits, followed by a space or tab and a non-digit); leave them out. Merging or splitting lines is credited as the smaller line count only when the entry's lines, joined in order, are otherwise identical and one side's line breaks are a subset of the other's (a moved break or a merge combined with a reordering is not credited); otherwise the merged or split lines count as missed and extra.

education.description: Formal education: degrees, diplomas and academic programs from universities, colleges and schools. Certifications, licenses, training courses, workshops and memberships are not education entries; a membership line printed inside an education entry stays in its description. Empty items list if the resume has none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

items.description: One item per program, in printed order.

institution.description: Pairing field: education entries are paired on institution + degree level (the level is read from studyType and area; a level that cannot be read, or "other", pairs with any; two different known levels never pair, so the whole entry is lost). Name of the school, college or university exactly as printed.

area.description: Field of study, major or specialization as printed (e.g. "Computer Science"). Compared together with studyType as one degree (see studyType); "CS", "IT" or "EE" here equal the spelled-out field, and the order of the field words is not scored. Do not repeat words that are already in studyType.

studyType.description: The degree words as printed, e.g. "Bachelor of Science", "B.S.", "Master's", "MBA", "Ph.D.", "High School Diploma", "Diploma". Null if no degree is printed (then the program or field goes in area). studyType and area are compared together as ONE degree: level + degree type + field, folding letter case, accents, punctuation, possessives, the plurals Bachelors/Masters/Associates, Levels and GCSEs (no other plurals) and a degree abbreviation at the start of studyType ("B.S." = "BSc" = "Bachelor of Science", "Bachelor's" = "Bachelors", "MBA" = "Master of Business Administration"); an abbreviation after a word that is not a degree ("Executive MBA", "Pursuing B.S."; a second degree after a comma, as in "B.S., MBA", is read as a degree) and school-leaving or diploma abbreviations (HSC, GED, HND) are compared as written; these degree abbreviations that include the field equal their spelled-out form: BSN, BScN, BSBA, BSE, BSCS, BSEE, BSME, BSCE, BSIT, MSN, MSE, MSF, MSCS, MSEE, MSME, MSIT, MSDS ("BSN" = "Bachelor of Science in Nursing"); other such abbreviations are compared as written ("MSIS" stays "MSIS"). A bracketed degree abbreviation that restates the same degree is ignored ("Bachelor of Science (B.S.)" = "Bachelor of Science", "Master of Engineering (M.E.)" = "Master of Engineering"); school-leaving and diploma abbreviations in brackets ("(HSC)", "(SSC)", "(HND)", "(PGDM)", "(GCSE)") count as written, so copy them exactly as printed. Between degree and field, a comma, colon, slash, brackets, "|", "in", "&", "with", a dash or no separator count the same ("Bachelor of Science Nursing" = "Bachelor of Science in Nursing"); words in front of the type make a different type ("Bachelor of Applied Science" is not "Bachelor of Science" + "Applied Mathematics"). Ignored: filler words (degree, major, concentration, specialization, expected, pursuing, full-time, and, of ...), the order of the field words (a minor written as "Minor: X", "Minors: X" or "Minor in X" stays a minor: "Economics, Minor: Statistics" is not "Statistics, Minor: Economics"; several minors may come in any order), a printed year and everything from "GPA", "CGPA" or "percentage" on. "Diploma" and "Certificate" count only as the level they give ("Diploma in Nursing" = "Certificate in Nursing"). An equal degree earns all its units, however it is split between studyType and area. Levels must agree ("other", for degree words that name no level, agrees only with "other"; a side with no studyType and no level word in area has no level, so leaving out a printed studyType, or adding one that is not printed, loses that unit; two different known levels do not pair at all); the type (Science, Arts ...) is a wildcard when one side omits it. When the degrees differ: both fields on both sides = one unit for level + type and one for the field of study together with any other degree words ("Honours", "Executive"); one field on both sides = no unit ("Executive MBA" is not "MBA"); one field against two = its unit when it equals either of the other side's fields or holds only a level and type that agree. Copy every printed degree word exactly once across studyType and area.

score.description: GPA, grade, percentage or class as printed (e.g. "3.8/4.0", "GPA: 3.8/4.0", "First Class Honours", "86%"). A leading label word (GPA, CGPA, CPI, SGPA, Grade, Percentage, Marks or Score, with its ":", "-" or "–"; not "—") and a trailing GPA/CGPA/CPI/SGPA are ignored; everything else in the value counts.

startMonth.description: Month study started, integer 1-12 (January = 1). Null if no month is printed (year only, season or quarter).

startYear.description: Year study started, 4-digit integer. For an ongoing entry ("2020 - Present", "Since 2020") the printed date is the start. Null if not printed. If only ONE date is printed and the entry is not ongoing, it is the end date (endMonth/endYear), not the start.

endMonth.description: Month study ended or is expected to end, integer 1-12 (an expected completion month goes here too). Null if no end month is printed.

endYear.description: Year study ended or is expected to end, 4-digit integer. A single printed date of a program that is not ongoing goes here, and so does an expected or anticipated completion date ("Expected May 2026") even though currentlyStudyHere is true. Null if ongoing with no printed end date, or if no end is printed. (When the ground truth has a single date, that date is also accepted in the start fields or in both.)

currentlyStudyHere.description: true if the person is studying here now: "Present", "Current", an open range, or an expected or anticipated completion ("Expected May 2026" -> true, with the expected date in endMonth/endYear). Otherwise false or null (they count the same: only true is compared).

location.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The full location of the entry as printed (e.g. "New York, NY, USA"). Null if none.

city.description: City (or town/district) part of the location printed with the institution, as printed. city, state and country are compared as one set of parts, ignoring case: a part in another slot is not penalized, a missing or extra part is. Every printed part must be its own value ("Austin, TX" in city matches neither part); copy parts as printed (no expansion such as "NY" -> "New York", no translation) and do not infer a part that is not printed (no country from a city).

state.description: State, province or region part of the location printed with the institution, as printed (e.g. "NY" from "New York, NY"). Null if not printed. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

country.description: Country part of the location printed with the institution, as printed (e.g. "USA" from "New York, NY, USA"). Null if not printed; never inferred. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

description.description: Lines printed under the entry: coursework, honours, thesis, activities and student clubs, one string per printed bullet or line, verbatim. Not the GPA, institution, degree, dates or location. Compared as an unordered set of lines: order is not scored, and list markers at the start of a line are ignored (one bullet glyph or symbol such as • ▪ ➤ ◆ ✔ 🚀, with or without a space; a dash or "*" followed by a space or tab; "1.", "1)" or "(1)" with one or two digits, followed by a space or tab and a non-digit); leave them out. Merging or splitting lines is credited as the smaller line count only when the entry's lines, joined in order, are otherwise identical and one side's line breaks are a subset of the other's (a moved break or a merge combined with a reordering is not credited); otherwise the merged or split lines count as missed and extra.

projects.description: Projects from a dedicated projects section. Empty items list if the resume has none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

items.description: One item per project, in printed order.

name.description: Pairing field: projects are paired on name. Project name or title exactly as printed.

description.description: Bullet points or lines of the project, one string per printed bullet or paragraph, verbatim. Compared as an unordered set of lines: order is not scored, and list markers at the start of a line are ignored (one bullet glyph or symbol such as • ▪ ➤ ◆ ✔ 🚀, with or without a space; a dash or "*" followed by a space or tab; "1.", "1)" or "(1)" with one or two digits, followed by a space or tab and a non-digit); leave them out. Merging or splitting lines is credited as the smaller line count only when the entry's lines, joined in order, are otherwise identical and one side's line breaks are a subset of the other's (a moved break or a merge combined with a reordering is not credited); otherwise the merged or split lines count as missed and extra.

startYear.description: Year the project started, 4-digit integer. For an ongoing entry ("2020 - Present", "Since 2020") the printed date is the start. Null if not printed. If only ONE date is printed and the entry is not ongoing, it is the end date (endMonth/endYear), not the start.

endYear.description: Year the project ended, 4-digit integer; a single printed date of an entry that is not ongoing goes here. Null if ongoing (inProgress true) or if no end is printed. (When the ground truth has a single date, that date is also accepted in the start fields or in both.)

url.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Link printed with the project (project page or repository): href = the URL if it is printed (otherwise null), label = the visible text of the link. Null if no link is printed.

href.description: UNSCORED (never compared). URL as printed; null if only the linked text is visible.

label.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Visible text of the link as printed.

companyName.description: Organization or client the project was for, as printed. Null if not printed.

location.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The full location of the entry as printed (e.g. "New York, NY, USA"). Null if none.

city.description: City (or town/district) part of the location printed with the project, as printed. city, state and country are compared as one set of parts, ignoring case: a part in another slot is not penalized, a missing or extra part is. Every printed part must be its own value ("Austin, TX" in city matches neither part); copy parts as printed (no expansion such as "NY" -> "New York", no translation) and do not infer a part that is not printed (no country from a city).

state.description: State, province or region part of the location printed with the project, as printed (e.g. "NY" from "New York, NY"). Null if not printed. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

country.description: Country part of the location printed with the project, as printed (e.g. "USA" from "New York, NY, USA"). Null if not printed; never inferred. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

startMonth.description: Month the project started, integer 1-12 (January = 1). Null if no month is printed (year only, season or quarter).

endMonth.description: Month the project ended, integer 1-12. Null if ongoing or if no end month is printed.

inProgress.description: true if the project is ongoing ("Present", "Ongoing", an open range). Otherwise false or null (they count the same: only true is compared).

personalSummary.description: The summary, profile or objective section (normally near the top). A second summary-like section with its own heading goes to customSections.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

text.description: The summary as printed, verbatim: one line per printed paragraph or bullet, lines separated by newlines (blank lines allowed); never break a line inside a paragraph or bullet. Compared as a set of lines; the same text broken into lines differently still counts in full. Leave list markers out (they are ignored only when at least two lines carry one). Null if there is no summary.

certifications.description: Certifications, certificates, licenses/licences, credentials and professional training or courses. Decided by the printed heading, in this order: (1) a heading that names certifications or certificates goes here with every item, including admission, membership or license lines under it ("Bar Admissions & Certifications", "Certifications & Professional Memberships"); if it also names another standard section ("Certifications & Skills"), it is split item by item; (2) otherwise a heading that names admissions, memberships, affiliations, professional associations, military service, military education or military training ("Bar Admissions", "Admissions & Licenses", "Military Education & Training") goes to customSections; (3) otherwise a heading that names licenses, tickets, credentials, accreditations, registrations, professional qualifications, training, courses or professional development goes here when its items are credentials, training or courses the person holds or completed, unless the section is written as prose paragraphs; other uses of these words follow meaning ("Training Courses Offered" listing courses the person teaches goes to customSections). Also certificates, licenses or training courses printed inside the education section that are not degree or diploma programs, and the certificates of a section that mixes them with other items (see awards). A membership, affiliation or admission printed inside any other section stays there. Lines printed under a certification (course content, outcomes) go to customSections under the printed heading of the section that holds them. Empty items list if none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

items.description: One item per printed certification, in printed order.

name.description: Pairing field: certifications are paired on name + issuer. Certification, license or course name exactly as printed.

issuer.description: Pairing field: issuing organization, only if printed with the item; null otherwise. Never inferred from the certification name: a missing or invented issuer loses the entry.

date.description: Date as printed, as a string (e.g. "Mar 2023", "2019", "2019 - 2021"). Not converted to integers.

url.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Link printed with the certification: href = the URL if it is printed (otherwise null), label = the visible text of the link. Null if no link is printed.

href.description: UNSCORED (never compared). URL as printed; null if only the linked text is visible.

label.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Visible text of the link as printed.

awards.description: Named awards, honours, prizes, scholarships, fellowships, distinctions, decorations and recognitions granted to the person, from a section headed Awards, Honors/Honours, Recognition, Prizes, Scholarships or similar, and the named awards of an Achievements section. A separately headed section that mixes items of a standard owner with other items (an Achievements or "Awards & Achievements" section with named awards, certificates or languages next to things the person did) is split item by item: each named award (the award's name, with its date, awarder or a short note; not a sentence about what the person did) goes here, each certificate to certifications, each language to languages, and the other items stay together in customSections under the printed heading. Job results stay in experience; volunteer and board roles go to volunteering. Empty items list if none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

items.description: One item per award, in printed order.

title.description: Pairing field: awards are paired on title. Name of the award or honour exactly as printed.

awarder.description: Organization that granted the award, if printed. Null otherwise; never inferred.

date.description: Date as printed, as a string. Not converted to integers.

summary.description: Other text printed with the award, verbatim. Compared as one string. Null if none.

url.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Link printed with the award: href = the URL if it is printed (otherwise null), label = the visible text of the link. Null if no link is printed.

href.description: UNSCORED (never compared). URL as printed; null if only the linked text is visible.

label.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Visible text of the link as printed.

volunteering.description: Volunteer, community-service and board roles from a volunteering, community or board section ("Board & Advisory", "Board Memberships"). Student clubs and extracurricular activities are not volunteering; in a section that mixes them with volunteer roles ("Leadership and Volunteering"), the volunteer roles come here and the other items go to customSections under the printed heading. Empty items list if none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

items.description: One item per role, in printed order.

organization.description: Pairing field: volunteering entries are paired on organization + position. Organization name exactly as printed.

position.description: Pairing field: volunteer role or title exactly as printed.

description.description: Bullet points of the role, one string per printed bullet, verbatim. Compared as an unordered set of lines: order is not scored, and list markers at the start of a line are ignored (one bullet glyph or symbol such as • ▪ ➤ ◆ ✔ 🚀, with or without a space; a dash or "*" followed by a space or tab; "1.", "1)" or "(1)" with one or two digits, followed by a space or tab and a non-digit); leave them out. Merging or splitting lines is credited as the smaller line count only when the entry's lines, joined in order, are otherwise identical and one side's line breaks are a subset of the other's (a moved break or a merge combined with a reordering is not credited); otherwise the merged or split lines count as missed and extra.

startYear.description: Year the volunteer role started, 4-digit integer. For an ongoing entry ("2020 - Present", "Since 2020") the printed date is the start. Null if not printed. If only ONE date is printed and the entry is not ongoing, it is the end date (endMonth/endYear), not the start.

endYear.description: Year the volunteer role ended, 4-digit integer; a single printed date of an entry that is not ongoing goes here. Null if ongoing (currentlyVolunteerHere true) or if no end is printed. (When the ground truth has a single date, that date is also accepted in the start fields or in both.)

currentlyVolunteerHere.description: true if the role is ongoing ("Present", "Current", "Since 2020", an open range). Otherwise false or null (they count the same: only true is compared).

startMonth.description: Month the volunteer role started, integer 1-12 (January = 1). Null if no month is printed (year only, season or quarter).

endMonth.description: Month the volunteer role ended, integer 1-12. Null if ongoing or if no end month is printed.

location.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The full location of the entry as printed (e.g. "New York, NY, USA"). Null if none.

city.description: City (or town/district) part of the location printed with the volunteer role, as printed. city, state and country are compared as one set of parts, ignoring case: a part in another slot is not penalized, a missing or extra part is. Every printed part must be its own value ("Austin, TX" in city matches neither part); copy parts as printed (no expansion such as "NY" -> "New York", no translation) and do not infer a part that is not printed (no country from a city).

state.description: State, province or region part of the location printed with the volunteer role, as printed (e.g. "NY" from "New York, NY"). Null if not printed. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

country.description: Country part of the location printed with the volunteer role, as printed (e.g. "USA" from "New York, NY, USA"). Null if not printed; never inferred. Compared as part of the location set (see city).

summary.description: Unbulleted prose printed in the entry, verbatim. Compared as one string. If it is written as the first description line(s) instead (or the ground truth did so), the scorer moves those lines here when, joined, they equal the prose. Null if none.

skills.description: Skill keywords from the resume's skills section: every section whose heading names skills ("Skills", "Technical Skills", "Key Skills", "Core Skills", "IT Skills", "Top Skills") or is a skills synonym ("Technical Proficiency", "Tech Stack", "Toolbox", "Toolkit"), and an unheaded block of skill keywords; if the resume has none of these, the first separately headed section of skill keywords under another heading ("Core Competencies", "Areas of Expertise", "Key Strengths", "Know-How"). Any other separately headed skill-like section goes to customSections under its printed heading. A skills-type section, or a group under its own printed label, whose items are mostly sentences (what the person did or does, e.g. "Created and deployed control frameworks ...", or a description of the person, e.g. "Able to work under pressure") goes whole to customSections. Spoken languages go to languages. Empty items list if none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

items.description: One object per printed category, or a single object for an uncategorized list.

category.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Category label printed inside the skills section, as printed ("Tools" from "Tools: Git, Docker", or a sub-heading; the heading of a second skills-named section). "Skills" or null for an uncategorized list. Never a skill name.

skills.description: Every item printed under this category, one string per printed item, verbatim: names of skills, tools, technologies, methods or areas of knowledge (words or noun or "-ing" phrases, with any bracketed detail, e.g. "Python", "Statistical Process Control (SPC)", "Excellent communication skills"). Keep an occasional longer phrase of a keyword section as printed; never cut a sentence into keywords. Items separated by "•", "·" or line breaks are separate strings. The scorer splits every string at each "," and "|" on both sides (also inside brackets; not at "，", "、" or ";"), so "Python, Java" as one string equals "Python" + "Java"; keep a bracketed group as printed in one string ("MS Office (Word, Excel)"). Compared like other text (letter case counts, except that ALL-CAPS text (two or more letters, all capitals) equals the same text in any case); list markers at the start are ignored; a repeated skill counts once (repeats are found ignoring case and the first spelling is kept).

publications.description: Publications and research papers from a publications or research section. Empty items list if none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

items.description: One item per publication, in printed order.

name.description: Title of the publication exactly as printed. Publications are paired on the best overall match of their fields.

publisher.description: Journal, conference or publisher as printed. Null if not printed.

date.description: Publication date as printed, as a string. Not converted to integers.

summary.description: Other text printed with the publication (authors, volume, pages, a description), verbatim. Compared as one string. Null if none.

languages.description: Spoken or written natural languages, wherever printed (also a language line inside a skills or Personal Details section). Programming languages go to skills. Empty items list if none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

items.description: One item per language, in printed order.

name.description: The language only, as printed ("English", not "English (Native)"). One item per language: split "English, Spanish and French" into three items; names joined with "/" ("Urdu / Punjabi") stay one item. The scorer also accepts "English (Native)", "English - C1" or "English: Fluent" written here when level is empty and the last part in brackets, the part after a colon or the part after a dash with spaces is a proficiency (native, fluent, C1, nativo, courant ...; "Chinese (Mandarin) - Native" = "Chinese (Mandarin)" + "Native"); otherwise that part stays in the name ("Chinese (Mandarin)", "Serbo-Croatian"). Put a printed level in level. Languages are paired on the best overall match.

level.description: Proficiency exactly as printed (e.g. "Native", "Fluent", "C1", "fluent, TOEIC 965"). Null if no level is printed. Compared only where the ground truth records a level.

interests.description: Hobbies and interests from an interests or hobbies section. Empty items list if none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

name.description: One interest or hobby per item, as printed.

profiles.description: Online profiles other than LinkedIn (GitHub, portfolio, personal website, X/Twitter, Behance, Kaggle ...). LinkedIn goes only to basics.linkedinUrl. Profiles are compared on network only, ignoring case. Empty items list if none.

sectionTitle.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The section heading as printed. Null if no heading is printed.

network.description: The name printed with the link ("GitHub", "Portfolio", "Blog"); if only the URL is printed, the name of the site it points to (github.com -> "GitHub", orcid.org -> "ORCID"), or "Portfolio" for a personal website with no printed name. Compared ignoring case. Profiles are paired on the best overall match.

url.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Link printed for the profile: href = the URL if it is printed (otherwise null), label = the visible text of the link. Null if no link is printed.

href.description: UNSCORED (never compared). URL as printed; null if only the linked text is visible.

label.description: UNSCORED (never compared). Visible text of the link as printed.

customSections.description: Every printed section that has no standard owner, one object per section, under its printed heading: e.g. Key Achievements / Achievements / Accomplishments listing things the person did, Professional Memberships, Affiliations, Professional Associations, Bar Admissions, Admissions & Licenses, Military Education & Training, Military Service, Security Clearance, Speaking Engagements, Patents, Personal Details, References, Declaration, Additional Information, a career-summary list of roles without responsibilities, a separately headed extracurricular-activities section, a second summary-like section, a skill-like section that is not the skills section, and a skills-type section written in sentences. Also the other items of a section split item by item (see awards and volunteering), and lines printed under a certification (under the printed heading of the section that holds them). Never copy content that a standard section holds. A Personal Details section keeps here only its lines that fill no other field (marital status, place of birth, notice period, driving licence ...): a line that fills a basics field (contact details, location, dob, gender, nationality, address, postalCode) goes to basics only and a language line to languages only; there is no custom section if no such line remains. Empty list if none.

sectionTitle.description: Pairing field: custom sections are paired on sectionTitle. The heading exactly as printed: do not rename, translate or normalize it; a trailing ":" or "." does not matter, and letter case counts, except that ALL-CAPS text (two or more letters, all capitals) equals the same text in any case. Write a letter-spaced heading as normal words ("A C H I E V E M E N T S" -> "ACHIEVEMENTS"). Null only if the section has no printed heading.

summary.description: Prose paragraphs of the section, verbatim, one line per paragraph. Compared as one string. If the ground truth has this prose in summary and the output wrote the same text as the first description line(s), it still counts (ground-truth list items written as one summary paragraph count as one merged line); do not split one section's prose between summary and description. Null if none.

description.description: List items of the section, one string per printed item or line, verbatim, in printed order; a sub-heading is its own item, in place. Plain text, no markdown. Compared as an unordered set of lines: order is not scored, and list markers at the start of a line are ignored (one bullet glyph or symbol such as • ▪ ➤ ◆ ✔ 🚀, with or without a space; a dash or "*" followed by a space or tab; "1.", "1)" or "(1)" with one or two digits, followed by a space or tab and a non-digit); leave them out. Merging or splitting lines is credited as the smaller line count only when the entry's lines, joined in order, are otherwise identical and one side's line breaks are a subset of the other's (a moved break or a merge combined with a reordering is not credited); otherwise the merged or split lines count as missed and extra.

layout.description: UNSCORED (never compared). The sections in reading order as a list of blocks, top to bottom; each block is a list of section names (standard keys such as "basics", "summary", "experience", "education", "skills"; the printed heading for a custom section). For a multi-column part, give one block per column, left column first. Only sections the resume has.

items.description: A block: the names of the sections in it, top to bottom.
